about: Combat clarity (first strike, gained keywords, log reasons). Shared behavior cases: ParityGoldenTests.swift and ParityGoldenTest.kt must both meet every expectation. Schedules are delay/duration in seconds, three decimals.

keywords.name: gained double strike shows through the engine icon
keywords.rules:
Flying
Trample
Whenever a Dragon you control attacks, it gains double strike until end of turn.

keywords.name: gained keyword line in the live rules without an icon
keywords.rules:
Whenever this creature attacks, it gains double strike until end of turn.
Double strike

keywords.name: markup, reminder text and keyword lists; sentences never count
keywords.rules: Menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.) First strike, lifelink Creatures you control have flying.

keywords.name: engine menace icon with reach and vigilance lines
keywords that do not change combat damage are not combat badges

badges.name: narrow card keeps the most important badge and counts the rest

beats.name: XMage's first-strike step: Atarka strikes first, the deathtouch blocker dies before dealing damage
leaving the first-strike step: the trampling double striker hits the player
a blocked attacker whose blocker died deals no regular damage without trample
first-strike snapshot skipped: both beats in one batch, damage and deaths after the regular strikes
only a blocker has first strike: the step is still named
combat without first strike keeps a single beat
